usage: - Use 種 as a common verb for planting seeds, flowers, vegetables, or trees in everyday speech.
- It often appears with a plant or crop after it, like 種花 or 種菜; the object comes naturally after the verb.
- As a noun, 種 can also mean “seed” or “type/kind,” but in gardening lessons the verb meaning is usually the main one.
- This is a very basic, high-frequency word, so it is good for talking about home gardens, farms, and school projects.
